note: ns2 and ns3 are WASM ns/sample of Eval2 and Eval3 at the idea params, one thread in Node. has3d: Eval3 changes with z. eval3Varies shows each coordinate, an Eval3 ignoring y is an extrusion.

erosion-filter.params_text: bf=0.7,str=0.15,s0=0.15,sf=0.6,branch=0.3,oct=2,alt=1,target=0.5 (kernel=3 triangular is the proto default; window 3; add fd=1,fde=0.2 for a rough source)

cellular-edge-distance.params_text: EdgeMask mode=2,ew=0.05,jit=0.3933 (GridJitter 0.90; rings 0.3565 in 3D, 0.3294 in 4D); EdgeDistance mode=0; Bevel mode=1,bw=0.15; Cobble mode=6,bw=0.15

stamp-scatter.params_text: K=2,src=3,R=1.25,jit=0.5,Rmin=0.7 (stripes, best look); K=4,src=2,Rmin=0.4 (craters); K=2,src=1,R=1.25,jit=0.5,Rmin=1 (dense domes). fadep=3,fc=2,bgf=0.05 are now the defaults; fc=4 gives thinner creases and steeper slopes.

crater-field.params_text: shear=1,dens=1,rpow=1,oct=12,lac=1.45,f0=0.2,slope=2.2,replay=4,repf=0.7,base=0.05 (rpow=2 and dens 0.6-0.8 for a less even wide view; dmod=0.8,dmodf=0.15,dsoft=0.25 for clustered faded craters)

caustic-web.params_text: D=1.1,M=3,eps=0.08,gamma=0.5,hgt=2,fq=0.8 (auto damp 1/(1+0.6D)); M=2 as the economy setting

exchange-foam.params_text: K=5,koff=1,src=0 (Perlin) or src=4 (facet, 85 ns); out=2,gain=5 Margin

domain-warp-curl.params_text: oct=1,steps=4,A=1.25 (marble on bands) | oct=2,steps=4,A=1.25,gain=.4,src=1 (marble on fBm) | kind=1,steps=5,A=-1 (cushion plates) | kind=1,steps=12,A=-3.33 (flat plates)

shatter-bsp.params_text: perp=1,pj=0.35,levels=3,wdecay=0.85,width=0.06,ddecay=0.8,step=0.35,sdecay=0.62,keep=0.85,offr=0.5,jit=0.3933 (vol width=0.1). Simplex window root: t_critic2_nested style=1,levels=3,scale=0.85,width=0.06

vortex-phase.params_text: mode=0,sf=.3,F=1.5,q=1,eps=.05,boff=.37 (zebra/wood stripes with Y forks); mode=1,fr=30,q=3,boff=.37 (3D folded agate); wave=2 for a crisp mask

grounded-scatter.params_text: tilt=0,facet=6,fixn=1,cut=0.68,aspect=0.35,sink=0.4 (chiselled rocks, best); add size=0.5,dens=0.9,k=0.02 for rubble; tilt=0 alone for rounded stones; sink=1 for truly half buried; flagstones rot=0,slab=0.4,e=4,size=0.5,sink=0.15,tilt=1,hamp=1.5

pebble-pile.params_text: rmin=0.25,layers=8,sizej=0.3,comp=1 (terrain height); same with comp=0 for the hard occlusion stack; out=1 clast mosaic; edge=0.04 soft stack

lattice-phasor.params_text: layout=1,k=2,F=1.85,spread=1,pjit=1,eps=0.05 (labyrinth); layout=1,k=2,F=2.46,spread=0.15,field=1 (fingerprint/tiger). Hex spacing .816, so hex F1.85 matches corner F1.5 stripes per kernel.

presets.label: cheap and exact below breaking time

burgers-steepen.params_text: mode=7,K=13,pol=2,t=1.5,oct=1 (K about 3+6t); t=3: mode=7,K=21,pol=1; high octave: mode=7,K=13,pol=2,t=1.5,oct=5,gain=0.35; cheap and exact below breaking time: mode=0,N=5

gini-foam.params_text: rel=1,jit=0.8,press=0.1,S=0.25,sq=2 (3D rel=1,jit=0.7,press=0.1,S=0.25; top4=1 gives the F1..F4 form)

simplex-facet.params_text: pw=0.5,pf=0.5 (PL warp); no params = bare lattice, best for 3D volumes

plate-drift.params_text: mode=4,drift=0.2,rot=0.3,gap=0.2,tilt=0.25 (tilted slabs, window 16 for a basalt field); mode=1,drift=0.2,rot=0.3,gap=0.3,bevel=0.25,jit=0.8,prio=1 (bevel); mode=3,sfreq=1.5 (Lookup)

tile-split.params_text: bond=1,levels=2,mode=1,bw=2,stop=0.3,bal=0.3,bevel=0.12; parquet bond=3,mode=3,levels=0,grain=6; mortar 3D mode=4,width=0.08; hierarchical cracks mode=2,width=0.05,wdecay=0.6

bubble-pack.params_text: rmax=0.38,rmin=0.2,rpow=1.5,on=0.5,onf=1,lac=1.4,L=7,f0=0.4,rot0=0.5 (out=0 iso -0.97 balls, out=4 iso 0 cheese, out=1 parabolic, out=3 value)

transverse-dunes.params_text: phase=1,sf=.35,F=1,taper=.35,stoss=.8,round=.3,wind=.3,ripple=0 (relief --hscale 25); ripple=.06,rratio=8 for close range at w4

cellular-planes.params_text: S=0.06,jit=0.9,oct=4,lacn=2.3,gn=0.42 (relief --window 6 --hscale 90); single layer S<=0.4 needs jit=0.8

edge-fate-cells.params_text: Tapered: t_critic2_merged mode=5,width=0.05,bias=0.15,mf=0.7,t0=0.12,wmin=0.25. Merged stubs: mode=0,metric=2,kd=0.2,width=0.05,colours=3. Pebble: t_edge_fate_cells mode=1,power=6,gap=0.05,dome=0.3,domeprof=1
edge-fate-cells.proto_note: proto from the params text, ranked.json has t_edge_fate_cells

bond-tunnels.params_text: mode=0,p=0.6,rmin=0.1,rmax=0.17,chamber=0.2,hub=0.12,jit=0.12,stub=0.25,smooth=0.04 ; hide lattice with rot=1,rw=1,warp2=1,wfreq2=0.6,warp=0.12,wfreq=2.4 = DomainRotate + DomainWarpFractalProgressive(Octaves=2, Lacunarity=4, Gain=0.12) over DomainWarpGradient(Warp Amplitude=1 cell, Feature Scale=1.7 cells) ; thin rmin=0.05,rmax=0.08,chamber=0,smooth=0.02

fisk-meanders.params_text: jv=0,csmooth=0.1,chutew=0.75,amin=40,amax=150,sjit=10,oxa=115,pox=0.8,ljit=0.35,vjit=0.15,warp=2.5,warpf=0.05,warp2=0.18,warpf2=0.7 (others default; S=6 for sparse rivers; relief plain=0.25-0.3, hscale 18-22)

strata-bands.params_text: agate prof=1,bands=8,jit=0.9,lam=0.08,seam=0.6,seamd=0.8,drop=0.06,lat=0.4,latf=1.3 on src=4,sf=0.3; timber prof=3,bands=30,tpow=3,tdrop=0.1,tcon=0.65,tfreq=0.13,ajit=0.6 on src=7 (unchanged)

phason-waves.proto_note: params are for the mode in t_multigrid_noise, ranked.json has t_phason_waves which reads none of them

fractal-derivative.params_text: bf=0.7,mode=1,rot=1 (Swiss, warp .15, gain .6, Perlin basis, window 5)

tpms-noise.params_text: plain: fam=0; bone net at 5% air: per=1.5,a=6.6,wf=0.157,oct=2,wkern=1 with --iso 0.887; sponge: a=6.6,wf=0.157,oct=2,wkern=1

iso-distance.params_text: mode=1,oct=5,w=0.06,h=0.06,tapmean=1,gfloor=0.000001,sflo=0.5 (5 octave band; oct=3 for clean lines); mode=2,oct=3,P=0.6,w=0.05,h=0.06,tapmean=1,gfloor=0.000001,sflo=0.5 (contours)

cole-hopf-dunes.params_text: mode=8,K=13,nu=0.03,t=1.5 (defined soft fronts); mode=8,K=9,nu=0.06,t=1.5 (cheapest clean, softer)

dislocation-stripes.params_text: vortex-phase mode=0,sf=.3,F=1.5,boff=.37; sf sets fork density
dislocation-stripes.proto_note: proto from the params text, ranked.json has t_lattice_phasor

crystal-grains.params_text: gauge=3,rate=0.3,delay=0.4,jit=0.4; Zoned mode=3; Boundary mode=1; vol mode=1 iso -0.3

recursive-cut-noise.params_text: root=0,f=0.7,lac=1.5,levels=3,skip=0,jitter=0.5,taper=0.75,width=0.04 (Strata; relief and vol width=0.08). For the record only: root=2,f=1,lac=1.15,levels=6,jitter=0.5,taper=0.85,width=0.06

puffy-caps.params_text: gain=0.45,oct=5 (iso 0.47 for vol); graph: FractalFBm(Octaves=5, Gain=0.45, Source=SignedSquareRoot(Source=Max(LHS=CellularDistance(Distance Function=Euclidean Squared, Size Jitter=0.8, Output Min=1, Output Max=-7.6), RHS=0)))

phyllotaxis.params_text: c=0.1,maxn=2000 (single spiral); out=3 bracts; inst=1,c=0.11,maxn=80,R=0.8 (rosette field, K=2) in protos/t_phyllo_critic

phacelle-noise.params_text: gradient driven: bf=0.7,str=0.15,s0=0.15,sf=0.6,branch=0.3,oct=1,out=3 in t_erosion_filter; angle driven: angle=1,oct=1,out=3,sloperef=0 in t_gully_h

domain-quasicrystal.params_text: AddDimension(Source=AddDimension(Source=Checkerboard(Feature Scale=24), New Dimension Position=Gradient(Multiplier X=0.7071, Multiplier Y=0.7071)), New Dimension Position=Gradient(Multiplier X=-0.7071, Multiplier Y=0.7071))

fractal-shear-cascade.params_text: oct=4,slip=0.35,width=0.08,smooth=1,out=0 (self, smoky hairlines); out=1,oct=1,slip=0.15,width=0.02 (gentlest strata test, still no offset)

domain-kifs.params_text: fold=1,N=3,s=2,ox=1,oy=1,tile=4,ang=0,src=1; fold=2,N=3,s=2,ang=15,tile=8,src=1 is the one interesting frame

spanning-tunnels.params_text: mode=1 tree link rule only, used as Link=Tree in bond-tunnels (mode=1 there). Do not port the capsule kernel.

vector-simplex-length.params_text: lat=1,mode=0,f=0.5 (channel source); Length only as a by-product output of the TubeNoise Perlin kernel
